title: Share cursor
description: Addon to Share Everything Mod, when you're in an inventory menu such as a chest, barrel or inventory everybody will be able to see your mouse location.
body:
This mod is an addon to an already existing mod called Shared Everything, This mod adds the ability to see your friends cursor!


<details>
<summary>Features</summary>
When in a Ui such as chests, barrels, crafing table, furnaces you can see your other friends cursors! It will be harder to troll with this mod, because if you try to drop an item within a chest or inventory someone could steal the loot before you get a chance to drop it!

Adding more soon
</details>

Mod requires [Shared Everything](https://modrinth.com/mod/shared-everything) and [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) (It will automatically install when you download the mod)
